raw_html: [[Legendary Ice Shards Guard|Legendary Ice Shards Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Ice Shards Guard]]:''' This item stores the pitiless immovable power of the ice deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally comes to the surface, dealing an incredible amount of Cold damage to the attacker.
